svg.title: Map of: Christianity Anglican Persons in Australia by Toby Hudson
svg.desc: Christianity Anglican Persons (field 2715) as a fraction of total persons, in Australia, Australia, according to the 2011 census. The map is divided into geographical subdivisions by Statistical Local Area. This graphic uses data from the Australian Bureau of Statistics, under the CC-BY-2.5-AU license.
